title: Microsoft 365 admin center: pay for Copilot Chat from prepaid capacity packs alone
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly leaves the environment's pay-as-you-go overage setting undocumented, although Microsoft describes its effect for capacity-managed environments including Copilot Chat. The roadmap facts, prepaid licensing and allocation API are supported; several navigation and source-disagreement qualifications also need correction.
